actions.action: Rotate uncertain diagnoses through bounded work turns
actions.mechanism: A review limit prevents one uncertain item from monopolizing a bench while waiting jobs repeatedly lose access.
actions.implementation: Set 15-minute diagnostic reviews, not completion promises. At safe stopping points, rotate to an unassessed item; prioritize one apparently short, safe job, then the oldest waiting job.
actions.check: Log bench turns; flag any eligible item bypassed for two rotations and any review overrun without a safety reason.
actions.risk: Stopping and restarting adds overhead; never force an unsafe pause.

actions.action: Separate intake screening from electrical bench access
actions.mechanism: Exterior-only intake lets volunteers establish ownership and routing without consuming specialist attention or opening electrical equipment.
actions.implementation: Assign one existing volunteer to record symptoms, electrical status, owner receipt number, and location. Queue electrical opening exclusively for the specialist; route uncertain classifications there too.
actions.check: Audit every electrical opening for specialist involvement and every accepted item for a matching receipt and recorded location.
actions.risk: Screening must not drift into electrical opening or testing.

actions.action: Move parts-blocked items into explicit waiting status
actions.mechanism: A separate status and off-bench location distinguish blocked inventory from actionable work without adding workbenches.
actions.implementation: Mark items WAITING FOR PART, recording the missing part, sourcing responsibility, and next review date. Move safely secured items to labeled existing storage; update the receipt-linked location.
actions.check: At shift end, verify each parts-blocked item has a location and sourcing owner; investigate any still occupying a bench.
actions.risk: If safe storage is unavailable, arrange owner collection instead.

actions.action: Require accepted responsibility at every shift handoff
actions.mechanism: Receipt-linked history preserves prior decisions while explicit acceptance prevents responsibility disappearing between shifts.
actions.implementation: Append dated notes recording volunteer, status, location, next action, and blocker. Incoming volunteers acknowledge assigned items; specialist-only actions remain restricted. Promise completion only with an explicit uncertainty range; otherwise report status.
actions.check: Before departure, outgoing volunteers reconcile every retained item against the log and confirm an incoming responsible person has accepted it.
actions.risk: Unaccepted items must remain visibly unresolved, not marked handed over.
